study.title: Dapagliflozin Monotherapy in Type 2 Diabetic Patients With Inadequate Glycemic Control by Diet and Exercise
study.design: 24-week randomized parallel-group double-blind placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
study.condition: Type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled with diet and exercise

master_study_rows: 24-week randomized parallel-group double-blind placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
Dapagliflozin Monotherapy in Type 2 Diabetic Patients With Inadequate Glycemic Control by Diet and Exercise
Type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled with diet and exercise

eligibility.qualifier: Treatment-naive patients with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled with diet and exercise alone.
Symptoms of severely uncontrolled diabetes, including >10% weight loss during the previous 3 months.
Significant renal, hepatic, hematological, oncological, endocrine, psychiatric, or rheumatic disease.
Cardiovascular event, including NYHA class III/IV congestive heart failure, within 6 months of enrollment.

PDF randomized N=559 and Mandros total N=558 represent different population scopes; corrected fields preserve randomized, baseline and treated counts separately.
Non-canonical Mandros outcome arm references were normalized to source-grounded canonical arm IDs in the corrected workbook.
All printed Table 1 baseline characteristics were transcribed for all nine displayed arms.
All printed non-NA Table 2 change outcomes were transcribed for all displayed arms; NA cells were not converted to results.
All Table 3 adverse-event categories were transcribed for all nine arms; each arm-event is one record with count, denominator and printed proportion in separate fields.
P-value operators and numeric values are in separate cells and stored once per comparison.
